name: robot-preview
description: VS Code extensions for previewing robot models, meshes, point clouds and Gaussian splats

scripts.build: vite build && npm --prefix packages/mesh-splat run build
scripts.package: vite build && cd packages/urdf-mjcf && npm run package && cd ../mesh-splat && npm run package
scripts.test: node --import ./tests/setup.mjs --test tests/animation/*.test.js tests/mjcf/*.test.js tests/viewer/*.test.mjs tests/extension/*.test.mjs tests/mesh-splat/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && npx -y -p node@22 node tests/e2e/webview.mjs && npx -y -p node@22 node tests/e2e/mesh-splat.mjs
